what_i_see: A vertically stacked structure in isometric view with a white cylindrical/conical tower body showing red and white striped banding, a flat gray platform or gallery deck around the middle-upper section, a small gray lantern room on top, and a yellow diagonal line representing a light beam. Two small green spheres sit at the base, possibly representing vegetation or rocks. The overall silhouette reads as a lighthouse but proportions are off — the gallery platform is too wide and dominant, making the tower look squat, and the base tapers oddly. The light beam is a nice touch.
